title: Common definitions
description: Shared building blocks referenced by every concrete deme content schema.

entityId.description: Stable, explicit identifier used for all cross-entity references. Lowercase kebab-case.

hook.description: The interaction event that triggers a script.

polygonPoints.description: A simple polygon as an ordered list of [x, y] vertices in the room's background image coordinate space.

scriptRef.description: A reference to a Lua script attached to an interaction hook. Exactly one of `scriptId` (a reference to a content/scripts/*.json entity) or `source` (inline Lua source) must be present.

scriptId.description: References the `id` of a content/scripts/*.json entity of type "script".

source.description: Inline Lua 5.4 source, run instead of a shared scriptId.

condition.description: Optional gate: this interaction entry is only offered to the engine's resolver when the condition holds against current GameState. Evaluated directly by the engine (not Lua) — see stateCondition.

effects.description: Optional GameState mutation applied by the engine when this interaction fires. Evaluated directly by the engine (not Lua) — see stateEffect.

stateCondition.description: A declarative gate evaluated by the engine against the current GameState (flags + inventory), independent of Lua scripting. `source`/`scriptId` remain reserved for future Lua execution (see architecture.md); this is plain data, not code, used to gate interactions and dialogue responses until that sandboxed scripting engine lands.

requiredFlags.description: All of these flags must be set.

forbiddenFlags.description: None of these flags may be set.

requiredItemIds.description: All of these item ids must be present in the player's inventory.

stateEffect.description: A declarative GameState mutation (flags only) applied directly by the engine, independent of Lua scripting. See stateCondition.
